title: Lunker County, My Fishing Game, Play it NOW
author: arcarsenal986
selftext:
Good morning, afternoon. 

After many weeks, I have an early release of my game, as of now its strictly fishing related. 

I intend to add other activities. 

The fishing is pretty well rounded. I'm balancing the fishing rods and starting gear still. Otherwise its a pretty relaxing game. Join tournaments for big cash prizes to upgrade your boat. Or just go fishing and sell your fish to the marina, or restaurant in town perhaps. 

There are quests from towns folk in Coldwater. Pressing Q on wildlife will give some factual information on the animal, and fill in your journal entries(Work in progress!) There is even a dog you can get to ride around with you. 

Watch out for geese, they're jerks!

You can let the title screen sit, and it will become a screensaver basically, it will tour the lakes, focus on different wild life.
